invariants.rationale: Methods returning complex result objects typically do not return null in modern codebases; null results may indicate an error.
Commit/instant times are expected to be non-null for write operations in Hudi.
The list of keys to delete should not be null at method exit.
The engine context is required for operations and should not be null at exit.
HoodieWriteMetadata should always provide a non-null list of WriteStatus objects.
